Use whenever the user says things like "学我的成功案例", "把这个案子做成案例分享", "写一个成功案例放到成功案例文件夹", or points at a client's case folder and a success-case library folder and asks to turn one into the other. Also covers touching up an already-generated case-study doc (e.g. "职业写得太精准了，模糊一下"). Triggers on requests to extract/summarize/anonymize a client case into shareable marketing copy — not on requests to just read or organize case files (that's the `it` skill), and not on drafting official USCIS filing content (that's the `case` skill).

skills.name: cs
skills.description: 凌图律师事务所（Lingtu Law）客户 intake 客服话术规范。当需要以律所 intake 工作人员身份接待客户初步咨询（移民、人身伤害 Personal Injury、信托遗产规划、民商事诉讼等）、需要介绍律所业务、回答客户案件相关问题、或引导客户留下联系方式完成登记时，务必使用本技能。只要对话涉及"客户咨询""案件类型""登记信息""拉群对接"等律所 intake 场景，即应触发本技能，不必等用户明确说"用 cs 技能"。

skills.name: eon-case-drive
skills.description: Build a new talent-immigration case folder in the 人才移民 Google shared drive for Lingtu Law / SIA 高徒: sort the intake into O-1 / EB1A / NIW, create the case Drive named 客户姓名+案件类型, lay out the standard subfolders (0. Intake, 0. Shared Folder, 1. Initial, 2. Form, 3. Petition Letter & Exhibits, 4. Final Scanned, 5. RFE, 6. Approval Letter, 弃用, plus NVC Letter on EB1A/NIW only), copy the PL template in, drop a blank 材料清单 and the intake note in, share only 0. Shared Folder with the client, and log it into the 案件总表 法律 tab. Builds one subfolder per statutory criterion there (EB1A 10, O-1A 8, O-1B 6, NIW 3 prongs, plus 工会信/offer/Personal Statement). Use whenever an intake hand-off arrives for an O-1A / O-1B / EB-1A / NIW client — name + email + 申请种类 + intake note, or 新客户建文件夹 / O1客户建case drive / 把这个intake建成案子 — and for follow-ups: later intake notes, re-sharing, criteria folders, fixing the tracking row. Triggers without the word skill. For SIA 高徒 case types (I-131, I-485, family-based, H1B) use the it skill.

skills.name: skye-forms
skills.description: Auto-fill the USCIS and DOL forms for any 人才移民 petition at Lingtu Law, routing by case type first — O-1A/O-1B (I-129 with the O and P supplement, I-907, three G-1650s), EB-1A (I-140, G-1145) and EB-2 NIW (I-140 plus ETA-9089 Appendix A, Appendix C and Final Determination) — with G-28 when the firm is attorney of record, I-907 when premium processing is requested, and one G-1650 per fee. Each run reads that case's 填表指令 doc and writes the filled forms into the client Drive folder the user names. Blank forms are always downloaded fresh from uscis.gov and dol.gov and each edition date checked first. Use whenever forms need filling, checking or regenerating: 填表, 填O1表格, 填EB1A表格, 填NIW表格, 填140, 帮XX客户填表, 有G28还是无G28, 9089怎么填, 加急要不要交907, 几张1650, 核对表格版本, 换新版表格重填. Also for a single form and for current editions or fees.
